_note: Values for the Bedrock 'Submit use case details for Anthropic' form. The console caps useCases at 500 characters - the string below is 497. Kept here so a resubmission says exactly the same thing.
_supersedes: The 2026-08-04 version described Agora as helping 'international students in Germany find part-time work'. That no longer matches the product or the website: the audience is every kind of work — kitchen, warehouse, delivery, care, retail, trades, office — and students are not the framing. The reviewer visits joinagora.eu, so submitting the old text against the new site would be a mismatch, which is itself a rejection risk.
_beforeSubmitting: The live site must already match this text. The reviewer opens the URL and reads it.

/impressum and /datenschutz must be real pages. Until 2026-08-06 they were 'coming soon' placeholders while the footer promised 'GDPR-first, your data never leaves the EU' — a reviewer assessing an AI use case would have seen that contradiction immediately.
Every [[PLACEHOLDER]] in apps/website/src/content/legal.ts must be filled with real details first. Shipping the Impressum with placeholders is worse than not shipping it.
Do not claim global coverage. 786 of 921 indexed roles are Berlin and all five sources are German; the site says 'starting in Germany' and this text agrees with it.
industryOption: Software / Technology (pick nearest available; Staffing & Recruiting also fits)
useCases: Agora helps people find work - from kitchen and warehouse to office roles - starting in Germany. We use Claude to draft tailored CVs and cover letters from a user's own profile and a chosen job ad, summarise CVs into structured skills, explain why a job matched, and generate interview practice questions. Output goes only to the user who asked for it. They review every document and click apply themselves - we never auto-submit, and never train models on user data. EU-hosted and GDPR compliant.
